replay.extension: After completion and Start restart, run 400 more updates: right for stress<140; then stress%80<2 jump, <5 up/right/dash, otherwise right when stress%160<80, left otherwise. native_map_oracle.qualification: The 32-pixel average-run gate is conservative, not a guarantee of improvement in every workload. This fragmented fixture is within 1% at median; mutation spikes are eliminated.
